about_short_description.short_description: Purity for Information Technology engages in the field of information technology.

product.name: IT Infrastructure Services
product.description: Services to improve IT infrastructure efficiency, availability, and security, including management and protection against threats.

product.name: Cloud Services
product.description: Cloud-based solutions including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), cloud management, monitoring, optimization, disaster recovery, backup, and public cloud migration.

product.name: Business Applications Managed Services
product.description: Management and support of business applications including data visualization, reporting, data warehousing, big data, and application development.

product.name: Software Development Services
product.description: Custom software development, modernization, integration, and DevOps planning to build and improve applications and systems.

product.name: Professional & Information Management Solutions
product.description: Data management and analytics services including data integration, governance, warehousing, business intelligence, AI, and machine learning.

product.name: IT Consulting and Advisory Services
product.description: Consulting services to define IT strategy, design solutions, and plan roadmaps aligned with business needs.
